description: This Java source file contains integration tests for client loan charges with external identifiers within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup procedures, test cases for saving and verifying external IDs on loan charges, and helper methods for creating loan products and applications.

classes.name: ClientLoanChargeExternalIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing external ID handling on client loan charges in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured setup and request/response specifications before each test.

methods.name: checkNewClientLoanChargeSavesExternalId
methods.description: Test case verifying that a new external ID is properly saved with a loan charge.

methods.name: checkNewClientLoanChargeFindsDuplicateExternalId
methods.description: Test case verifying that duplicate external IDs are rejected with a 403 error.

methods.name: getLoanChargeAsJSON
methods.description: Helper method to construct JSON string for a loan charge with external ID.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create and return a loan product ID based on provided parameters.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to create and submit a loan application, returning the loan ID.
